title: Introduce sparse-probe metric contract and perf-anchor changelog writer
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: onboarding new open models revealed gaps in the registry's ability to represent sparse probing results (few-shot/per-probe metrics) and to tie those sparse probes to concise changelog fragments for downstream release notes. This PR introduces a first-class 'sparse_probe' metric contract on model profiles, a perf-anchor concept that pins important probe baselines per model variant, and an automated changelog writer that emits compact 'perf anchor delta' snippets for release note drafts.

What changed (summary): added a schema extension for sparse_probe metrics, migration to populate anchors from recent evaluations, API changes to accept sparse_probe arrays, a registry CLI subcommand to summarize anchors (regctl anchors list), and a small background job that synthesizes changelog fragments when anchors drift beyond configured thresholds. Also wired the generator into the release assembler so onboarding flow can surface suggested perf-note blips.

Checklist: - [x] Schema: add sparse_probe and perf_anchor fields to profile v2 schema - [x] Migration: backfill anchors for variants with eval history - [x] API: accept sparse_probe payloads in onboarding endpoint - [x] CLI: regctl anchors list / apply - [x] Changelog writer: produce short perf-anchor delta snippets - [x] Tests: unit tests for schema coercion + integration test for writer output - [x] Docs: add onboarding guide section + example changelog snippet

Related: builds on prior work for onboard sampling (ENG-3180) and changelog automation (ENG-6450). This is intentionally conservative: anchors are optional metadata and the writer operates only when an explicit opt-in tag is present on the profile's onboarding bundle.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Good direction. Two requests: (1) ensure the migration is idempotent and won't re-run expensive DB scans in the event of partial failures; (2) prefer a narrower default threshold for delta detection (10% relative) and make it configurable.
Asha Patel: Addressed. Migration now writes a migration marker per-variant to avoid reprocessing; default delta threshold set to 8% relative with config override via REGISTRY_ANCHOR_DELTA_THRESHOLD.

Marisol Ruiz: The API shape looks fine but we should surface a compact example in the onboarding docs showing sparse_probe for multiple probe configs. Also flag the field as opt-in in the schema description.
Asha Patel: Added example payload and emphasized opt-in in schema docs. Also added an error path test for older clients sending stray fields.
Evan Goldberg: CI flake observed on first run (tests/integration/test_perf_anchor_changelog) due to a timing assumption in the writer job. Recommend using a deterministic clock in tests.
Asha Patel: Switched integration test to use a freeze_time fixture; re-ran CI and all checks passed. Thanks for the catch.
Liam Chen: Approving — the migration and writer look safe. Small nits left inline but not blocking.
release_notes: Added sparse_probe metric contract and perf_anchor changelog writer. Operators can opt-in to anchors in onboarding bundles; registry will backfill anchors from recent evals. New CLI commands: regctl anchors list, regctl anchors apply. Changelog automation will suggest perf delta snippets when anchors drift.
notes_for_ops: Migration will iterate variants with eval history; estimated windowed CPU work ~2h for large tenant clusters. Migration writes per-variant marker files; safe to retry. Anchor writer is opt-in and gated by onboarding metadata to avoid noisy notes on experimental models.
upgrade_instructions: 1) Deploy schema and API changes. 2) Run migration with backfill flag: python migrations/2025_02_14_backfill_perf_anchors.py --dry-run, then without --dry-run. 3) Enable anchor writer via REGISTRY_FEATURES=anchors in config or per-bundle opt-in. 4) Verify regctl anchors list shows anchors for known variants.
post_merge_tasks: - monitor anchor generation logs (logs/anchors) for 48h - add sampling rule to eval pipeline to ensure future anchors are captured - notify docs and release engineering to include perf note snippets in release drafts
